## Selected projects

Project summaries below are self-reported descriptions from the portfolio. Metrics are not independent performance guarantees.

### HireMind

- AI-powered recruiting and talent-matching platform.
- Portfolio description: matches candidates with jobs using LLMs and semantic embeddings, with candidate ranking, skill-gap analysis, and personalized recommendations. The portfolio reports matching 100+ candidates and 85%+ matching accuracy.
- Technologies listed: React.js, Node.js, AI/ML, LLMs, semantic embeddings, PostgreSQL.
- Live project: https://ai-powered-recruiting-talent-matchi.vercel.app/
- Source code: https://github.com/MdSaifAli063/HireMind

### AetherMind

- Adaptive AI conflict-resolution agent.
- Portfolio description: a nine-feature reasoning system including conflict resolution, emotion detection, response rewriting, mediation mode, what-if simulation, script generation, ethical filtering, feedback, and conflict history. The portfolio reports a 60% reduction in average conflict-resolution time.
- Technologies listed: PyTorch, OpenEnv, AI/ML, Python.
- Live project: https://huggingface.co/spaces/mdsaifali063/AetherMind
- Source code: https://github.com/MdSaifAli063/AetherMind

### ElectED

- AI education platform that provides context-aware guidance about the election process.
- Portfolio description: uses LLMs and semantic embeddings and reports a 90%+ query-relevance score in internal testing.
- Technologies listed: React.js, Node.js, AI/ML, LLMs, machine learning.
- Live project: https://election-process-education-assistan-three.vercel.app/
- Source code: https://github.com/MdSaifAli063/ElectED

### SafeGuard AI

- Personal-safety automation app for real-time emergency alerts.
- Portfolio description: reports SOS alerts in under three seconds without manual phone interaction, 99.9% uptime, and a 70% reduction in response-initiation time.
- Technologies listed: React.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, Vercel.
- Live project: https://safe-guard-ai-five.vercel.app/
- Source code: https://github.com/MdSaifAli063/SafeGuard-AI

### Medicine Reminder

- Medication scheduling and reminder application with a Python backend and responsive frontend.
- Technologies listed: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Python, Flask.
- Live project: https://medicine-reminder-yp3m.onrender.com/

### Eventronix

- Event and hackathon collaboration platform with AI roadmap generation, participant-team matching, and community features.
- Technologies listed: Flask, Python, MongoDB, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.
- Live project: https://event-platform-xp0r.onrender.com/

### ThermaGrid

- Geospatial Earth-observation project for urban heat-island detection and cooling optimization, submitted for the ISRO Space Hackathon.
- Portfolio description: combines Landsat-9 and Sentinel-2 data, ISRO Bhuvan feeds, physics-informed modeling, explainable analysis, and cooling optimization.
- Technologies listed: React.js, TypeScript, TanStack Query, AI/ML, data visualization.
- Live project: https://thermagrid-isro.vercel.app/

### CrimeIQ Karnataka

- Crime analytics and visualization platform described in the portfolio as an intelligence platform for Karnataka State Police (SCRB Intelligence Division).
- Portfolio description: geospatial heatmaps, predictive models, suspect-network visualizations, and district-level analytics.
- Technologies listed: React, TypeScript, TanStack Start/Router, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet, Recharts, React Force Graph, Zoho Catalyst.
- Live project: https://kspcrime-50043086176.development.catalystappsail.in/
